post.instagram_caption:
11 days ago, Jensen Huang quit Nvidia. Today he's back.

Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president and CEO, effective immediately. The board said it received input from senior levels of the US government that his return poses no national security risk. Board chair Harvey Jones: "The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA." Nvidia shares jumped more than 25% in premarket trading on Nov 23. The timeline: Nov 8 he admitted an affair, Nov 12 he resigned, Nov 23 he was reinstated.

Should one person matter this much to a $4 trillion company?
